arrival_toasts.text: The fissure Zevara spoke of is down past the gallery. The dark has a direction today.

_comment_unsteady: [Even Footing] placement 2: the (3,9) collapse band spills two cells east. NEW blocked cells -- blocked_cells 6 -> 8, dungeon_peek re-pinned. Non-holders swing a row (+2; +4 at (4,10)/(4,11)).
unsteady_toast: The spill shifts the moment you put weight on it and keeps shifting. Crossing that takes footing you have not got.

segments._comment: A fallen lintel span, interior texture only (ruin_surface's own minimal from/to-only precedent)

floor_layers._pick: Cemetery-floor variation reusing the dungeon biome's own verified floor-tile neighborhood (2,2)/(3,7) plus the genuinely darker worn variant (2,11) for real wear texture.

decor._comment: CASTLE 0.3 statue dressing, blocked-pair (THE BLOCKING CONTRACT).
CAVE rubble dressing (a collapse band), blocked-pair.
Same rubble family as (3,9) so the band reads continuous and the unsteady pair looks like ground, not wall.

entities._comment: GH#334 note 20: THE DUNGEON RETURN CARRIER -- the cluster had none, so the Door's dungeon row was one-way. Gates on this map's own portals counter; (2,5) keeps arrival (2,6) clear.
entities.toast: Set into the wall beside the landing, older than the rubble and colder than the air. The frame of light under its surface answers the moment you look at it.
entities.observe: The way out of here is cut into the wall stone, ward-lines deep in the face of it. Coin-gold veins the rock, the same gold that runs the courses overhead.

entities._comment: Met, it becomes a real door to `deep_tunnels`, landing at (13,5)
entities.observe: Rubble and worked stone choke a passage that led somewhere once. The stones sit in courses, and there is barely any dust on them.
entities.toast: The stone doesn't budge. Whatever's on the other side stays sealed. For now.

door_when.open_toast: The rubble gives at your push; the path through it was cleared before you got here. The old gallery beyond is dark, but it is open.

entities.observe: A carved figure crouches against the far wall, knees drawn up and arms folded in, its eyeless face bowed at the floor. It stays exactly as it is for as long as you stand there.
entities.toast: You keep your distance. A shallow arc is scored into the floor in front of it, ending under one folded knee.

entities._comment: Grouped with Yvlon/Ksmvr at (7,5)-(9,5), open floor clear of every blocked/decor/entity cell on this map. v0.15 T4.3 round 2: retires on horns_dig_started with the rest of the party. Her own `ceria_intro` banks that counter mid-conversation, which is why this gate needed world.gd's dialogue defer first. Contract: inn.json's `ceria_inn_returned`.
entities._comment_dig: Task 2.7 round 2 -- OWNING SITE for all three delve-staging Horns rows. They had no present_when at all, so once the inn-vs-camp bilocation was fixed the SAME bug relocated here: during The Dig a player could meet camp-Ceria at the ruin and delve-hub-Ceria on the approach in one trip. CURRENT CONTRACT (v0.15 T4.3 round 2, supersedes Task 2.7's horns_dig_joined): each row retires PERMANENTLY at horns_dig_STARTED, the counter the camp rows arm on, so the copy is gone the moment the dig begins rather than when it is joined. That counter was unusable until world.
